content.rendered:
This is a great opportunity for parents to learn what your students day will look like as we begin our year in Distance Learning Mode. You will have the opportunity to join one of two Back To School sessions. Be on the lookout for an email from your homeroom teacher with an invite to join the Zoom sessions.

Session One – Wednesday, September 16th 6:00 p.m.

Session Two – Wednesday, September 16th 7:00 p.m.
